name: MeHow Innovative Ltd.
summary: MeHow Innovative Ltd. designs, develops, manufactures, and sells precision medical device components and products in China and internationally. The company provides home ventilators, precision molds and automation equipment, surgical instruments, etc. It also offers variable dose pen, auto injector, auto secure dose pen; microfluidic solutions and laboratory consumables, such as cuvette, PCR tube, 96-well plates, freezing tubes, culture dish and bottle, suction head, and vacutainer; cardiovascular products, including electrophysiology, and ablation catheter, high density mapping catheter, and intracardiac echocardiography solutions; surgical solutions, such as ultrasonic scalpels, staplers, …
